name: Ultfave
domainStatus: Available at time of screening (Verisign WHOIS: No match for ULTFAVE.COM). ultfave.io, .co, .app, .fm and .net showed no NS records. Do not register until launch window.
tagline: Everyone has an ult fave. Prove it.
descriptor: Ultfave is a fan leaderboard for music listeners. Connect Spotify, earn points for listening minutes, distinct tracks and streaks, and climb weekly, monthly and yearly leaderboards for the artists you love.
category: Music fandom competition / listening stat tracker
audience: Superfans 16-34 on music Twitter and TikTok, across K-pop, indie, pop and electronic. Competitive, fluent in stan language, allergic to corporate dashboards.
positioning: For fans who measure devotion in repeat plays, Ultfave is the board that turns listening into standing. Per artist, per week, in public. It is a scoreboard written by the crowd, not an analytics product: your minutes make a rank, your streak makes a reputation, and your rivals are people you actually know.
whyItWins: Names the fan's own vocabulary (ult fave) instead of the product's function (fan rank).
Reads as a record-label or club imprint, not a SaaS dashboard.
Works for K-pop, indie and pop without leaning on a genre or a fandom name.
Ownable: no dictionary meaning, no existing product, empty .com and empty @handle on X.

contrast.note: All body copy passes WCAG 2.2 AA; fg and muted pass AAA. Never set cream on coral (2.79:1), cream on rose (3.12:1) or cream on periwinkle (1.97:1) as text. Line #40283A on panel is 1.38:1 and is decorative only; form-field borders use muted (7.80:1).

palette.ratio: 90% ink and cream, 7% coral, 3% rose/periwinkle/brass combined. Coral is the only action colour.

display.usage: Headlines, hero statements, page titles, artist names. Tracking -0.03em to -0.045em, line-height 0.88-1.0.

sans.usage: Body, UI labels, buttons, table cells. No display tracking below 14px.

mono.usage: Scores, ranks, deltas, timers, eyebrows, metadata. Tabular numerals on; uppercase labels at 0.16-0.20em tracking.

fonts.nextFontSnippet: import { Bricolage_Grotesque, Instrument_Sans, JetBrains_Mono } from "next/font/google"; const display = Bricolage_Grotesque({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-display", display: "swap" }); const sans = Instrument_Sans({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-sans", display: "swap" }); const mono = JetBrains_Mono({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-mono", display: "swap" });

logo.concept: The Folded U. A crate-solid U whose top-right corner turns down like a folded record-sleeve corner: the mark you leave on the thing you love. The counter is open, so the letter reads at 16px; the fold survives as a 45-degree bevel.
logo.construction: 64-unit grid, 52 x 56 shape, 16-unit strokes, 20-unit counter, 12-unit fold. Wordmark cap height 100, stem 20, tracking 8. Mark sits at 84% of cap height and on the baseline in the lockup.
logo.clearSpace: Half the mark width on all sides (26 units at 64). Minimum sizes: mark 16px, wordmark 120px wide, primary 160px wide.
logo.monochrome: logo-mark.svg and logo-wordmark.svg inherit currentColor and are single-colour by design. Primary uses fixed coral for the mark and currentColor for the wordmark: set color #F7EDE3 on ink, #150A12 on cream. Icon and favicon are ink plate plus coral. Never place the primary on coral or rose.

principles: Speak fan, not analyst. Use the words fans already use, then make them precise.
Score straight, celebrate loud. Numbers never exaggerate; reactions can.
Never punch down. Rivalry is a game between friends, not a war between fandoms.
Short lines. Hard stops. Caps for impact, not for volume.
Show the receipts. Points, privacy and rules are explained in plain language, on the page.
taglines: Everyone has an ult fave. Prove it.
For the ones you play on repeat.

descriptions.artist: See who really runs the {Artist} fandom this week. Live fan rankings built from listening minutes, distinct tracks and streaks. Free, and your data stays yours.

launchContent: The 25 fanbases with the deepest crates this week: a data story from distinct-track counts, updated weekly.
Wrapped is once a year. This is every Monday: a recurring 'week in devotion' post with three boards and one rivalry.
How the points work, in one scrollable page with a live calculator.
Streak Club: interview three fans with 30+ day streaks on the same artist.
Deep Cuts: the least-played track that still made a top-10 fan's week.
Rivalry of the Week: two friends, one artist, a 40-point gap, a shared card.
The 8-minute cap, explained: why a 12-minute track cannot buy a rank.
Artist page launch series: one page per artist with a hand-written scene note, not scraped biography text.
Fan card gallery: opted-in cards only, with rel=canonical to the owner's profile.
A public scoring changelog so the rules are auditable.

principles: Numbers count, surfaces do not bounce.
Overtakes get a 400ms coral wipe; everything else is 160-220ms.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; the board must be readable with motion off.
motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for entrances, cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1) for state changes
motion.texture: Fine grain at 3-5% over ink; a 1px printed rule between sections; no glass blur on leaderboard rows (legibility first).
